control: Сохранять четыре слоя: formal substrate; explicit computer ethics; machine/data ethics; institutional-policy consolidation.
needed_sources: Первичные editions, archive dates, journal histories, curriculum evidence.
risk: Соблазн начать field либо с Тьюринга, либо только с “AI ethics boom” 2016–2020.

control: Развести claim types: theorem, empirical result, design proposal, conceptual analysis, normative argument.
needed_sources: Full text, appendix/code, peer commentary, technical replication.
risk: Technical paper может содержать normative assumptions; философский текст может неверно описывать systems.

control: Каждому объекту давать system_type, capability_scope, deployment_domain and historical vocabulary.
needed_sources: Technical definitions, system docs, OECD/EU/NIST versions.
risk: Один label охватывает symbolic AI, ML, robotics, foundation/general-purpose systems and marketing.

control: Хранить metric node отдельно от moral/legal/social justice nodes; добавлять contested_by.
needed_sources: Formal papers, anti-discrimination law, critical race/feminist scholarship.
risk: Metric optimization может закрыть вопрос о institutions, history, power and remedy.

control: Фиксировать explanation_target, stakeholder, timing, fidelity, contestability and remedy.
needed_sources: Interpretability literature, model cards, legal guidance, user studies.
risk: Термины адресуют разные audiences and purposes.

control: Кодировать value_source, aggregation procedure, authorization and dissent/refusal.
needed_sources: Alignment papers, moral/political philosophy, governance documents.
risk: Alignment может означать objective satisfaction, user preference, institutional policy or moral legitimacy.

control: Создать parallel subgraphs and explicit trade-off/contestation edges.
needed_sources: Safety reports, FAccT literature, funding/institution records, policy debates.
risk: Один agenda может вытеснять другой и перераспределять funding/attention.

control: Моделировать human, institutional, technical and distributed agency separately.
needed_sources: Responsibility-gap literature, contracts, organizational charts, audit trails.
risk: Приписывание agency системе может скрывать organizations and supply chains.

control: Развести issuer, funder, binding force, independent review, implementation evidence and sanctions.
needed_sources: Governance texts, minutes, enforcement records, independent audits.
risk: Principles and boards могут легитимировать deployment без remedy and enforcement.

control: Добавить roles/funding/disclosure nodes; не выводить motive без evidence.
needed_sources: COI statements, sponsorship rules, grants, employment history, correspondence where public.
problem: Corporate capture and conflicts of interest
risk: Funding, employment and access shape agenda and publication.

control: Multilingual search, regional indexes, official translations, community repositories and coverage metadata.
needed_sources: National libraries, regional journals, AU/UNESCO/OECD portals, language-specific bibliography.
risk: PhilPapers/arXiv and top venues underrepresent local-language, community and noncommercial corpora.

control: Model collective rights, community governance, attribution, consent, refusal and benefit.
needed_sources: CARE, IEEE 2890, Indigenous governance documents, community-authored scholarship.
risk: Universal principles могут extract local concepts without authority or benefit.

control: Create work/version/status/jurisdiction nodes; snapshot retrieval date.
needed_sources: EUR-Lex, treaty status charts, NIST/ISO version pages, official gazettes.
risk: Application dates, amendments, consolidation and ratification change meaning.

control: Archive URLs, hashes, release tags, DOI/arXiv version, web captures and rights state.
needed_sources: Repositories, web archives, Crossref/DataCite metadata, institutional archives.
risk: Link rot, dynamic HTML, deleted model cards and withdrawn preprints erase evidence.
